clauses.quote: Any employee terminated or demoted pursuant to this policy shall have the following recall rights to a position for which he or she is certified, for one (1) calendar year from the effective date of his or her termination or demotion:
clauses.subject_text: Any employee terminated or demoted pursuant to this policy

clauses.quote: Tenured employees dismissed through staff reductions will, for a period of one year. be given priority consideration for re-employment if qualified by certificate and competency in the area of need, and if the employee has re-applied to the system for employment, in reverse order of dismissal before nontenured employees in the same area are added to the staff.
clauses.subject_text: Tenured employees dismissed through staff reductions

clauses.quote: Nontenured employees who have been dismissed through staff reduction and are qualified by certificate and competency in the area of need will, for a period of one year, be given priority consideration for re-employment in reverse order of dismissal before licensed employees in the same area are added to the staff.
clauses.subject_text: Nontenured employees who have been dismissed through staff reduction and are qualified by certificate and competency in the area of need

clauses.quote: If a former employee refuses an offer of employment pursuant to this policy, his or her rights of recall are forfeited.
clauses.subject_text: his or her rights of recall
clauses.notes: Condition detailing when a previously granted recall right is lost.
